# Chita Rivera Award for Outstanding Male Dancer in a Broadway Show

| sponsor = New York City Dance Alliance
}}
The Chita Rivera Award for Outstanding Male Dancer in a Broadway Show was an annual award presented to a male dancer for their work on a Broadway production. The award was included when the awards began in 1982, as the Fred and Adele Astaire Awards.
The award was separated from Off-Broadway productions, which received its own category, in 2017, when the awards were renamed in honor of Chita Rivera. The award was replaced by the gender-neutral Chita Rivera Award for Outstanding Dancers in a Broadway Show in 2023.
Gregg Burge, Norbert Leo Butz, Jared Grimes and Tony Yazbeck each won the award two times, the most of any performer. Hugh Jackman, Butz, Ephraim Sykes and Yazbeck hold the record for most nominations in the category, with three each.
